companyDescription: Crypto miner pivoting to Ethereum treasury/staking + AI/HPC infrastructure (WhiteFiber) · 158,462 ETH held · real, revenue-generating pivot, not a concept stage story
priceNote: Live-prices.json cache (1.4h old). Down further from the ~$1.83-1.87 range cited in recent news coverage — widening the gap to consensus targets.
summary: Bit Digital is mid-pivot from pure Bitcoin mining to an Ethereum treasury/staking + AI/HPC infrastructure model through majority-owned WhiteFiber — a real, executing business (Q1 2026 revenue $27.9M), not a concept-stage story. 5 analysts rate it Strong Buy with a consensus target ~$5.70-7.00, implying 248-327% upside from the current price. ⚠️ SURVIVAL: cash burn is real — Q1 2026 net loss was $57.7M against $79.5M cash on hand, and the company has been actively raising capital (25M+ new shares issued since year-end 2025, a proposed $100M convertible note offering). Included in top 5 despite the flag because the pivot is funding an actual, growing revenue business, not a going-concern rescue — see justification below.

catalysts.name: Ethereum Treasury + Staking Scale-Up
catalysts.description: Management is accelerating the ETH treasury/staking build — total holdings at ~158,462 ETH after adding 8,568 ETH for $20M. Ongoing accumulation, not a single dated event, but the core driver of the 'Strategic Asset Company' re-rate thesis.

catalysts.name: WhiteFiber AI/HPC Infrastructure Scaling
catalysts.description: Majority-owned WhiteFiber is Bit Digital's AI/HPC infrastructure arm — the growth engine behind the pivot away from pure Bitcoin mining. Revenue contribution here is the metric to watch each quarter.

catalysts.name: $100M Convertible Notes Offering
catalysts.description: Proposed registered underwritten offering of $100M aggregate principal convertible senior notes due 2030 (announced Sep 2025, still working through). Directly addresses the cash-runway risk flagged below — successful pricing would meaningfully extend runway without near-term equity dilution at today's depressed price.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: cash runway is genuinely tight — Q1 2026 net loss ($57.7M) exceeded 70% of the quarter-start cash balance ($79.5M→$79.5M end-of-quarter reported, down from $118.4M at YE2025); the company has an active $100M convertible note offering in progress plus ongoing ATM activity ($14.3M raised recently) and has already diluted shares outstanding from 324M to 349M since year-end. This is a real, live financing need, not a hypothetical.
Q1 2026 results were mixed — higher reported revenue but a wider net loss, and revenue fell 13.6% sequentially, landing right as investors were focused on the ETH/AI pivot narrative

Analyst target dispersion matters here — the $5.70 consensus and $7.00 HC Wainwright high both assume successful execution of the pivot; a stumble in either ETH treasury economics or WhiteFiber's AI/HPC ramp would remove the re-rate case entirely
Ethereum price exposure — a meaningful chunk of the thesis rides on ETH's own price and staking yield, an additional variable beyond company execution
Highly dilutive capital structure risk — if the convertible note offering doesn't price well, the company may need to lean harder on ATM equity sales at depressed prices, compounding dilution

estimateDates.note: Watch WhiteFiber revenue contribution and cash burn trajectory — the key data points for the survival thesis

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75%, but Chair Warsh's hawkish Jun debut FOMC keeps small-cap, capital-hungry names like BTBT exposed to a higher-for-longer path that raises the cost of the very capital raise this company needs.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE at 3.4% YoY (May) reinforces the hawkish setup into Jul 28-29 FOMC — timing matters for BTBT's convertible note pricing.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: HIGH — crypto-adjacent names are both high-beta to risk appetite and directly exposed to ETH price action; a risk-off macro tape would hit both the equity and the treasury asset simultaneously.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM-HIGH — a genuinely capital-constrained small-cap raising money into a hawkish-leaning, event-dense macro week (Jul 27-Aug 1 FOMC/earnings/PCE) faces real execution risk on financing terms, on top of the underlying business risk.
